article_title: Burnham 'ready to support' Poundland staff as retailer faces collapse

tasks.prompt: What is the central problem described in the article?
options: Poundland plans to close only its Irish Dealz stores.
Poundland faces possible administration after funding was restricted and a takeover bid was rejected.
The government has ordered Poundland to sell every store to Lidl.
Strong sales have caused Poundland to run out of stock.
tasks.correct_answer: Poundland faces possible administration after funding was restricted and a takeover bid was rejected.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הבעיה המרכזית היא סכנת קריסה ומינוי מנהלים מיוחדים לאחר הגבלת המימון ודחיית הצעת רכישה.

tasks.prompt: How long does the notice of intention give Poundland to find a rescue deal?
options: Three days
One month
Ten days
Six weeks
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הודעת הכוונה למנות מנהלים מיוחדים מעניקה לעסק עשרה ימים למציאת עסקת הצלה.

tasks.prompt: For how much did Gordon Brothers buy Poundland from Pepco last year?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: גורדון ברדרס רכשה את פאונדלנד במחיר סמלי של ליש״ט אחת.

tasks.prompt: What does “teeters on the brink of collapse” mean in this article?
options: The company is opening a new international division.
The company is close to failing.
The company is steadily increasing profits.
The company has completed a rescue sale.
tasks.correct_answer: The company is close to failing.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר חברה שנמצאת קרוב מאוד לקריסה, אך עדיין לא קרסה סופית.

tasks.prompt: Why might Gordon Brothers prefer breaking Poundland up rather than keeping it intact?
options: It says selling stores separately could recover more money for creditors.
It wants to convert all stores into warehouses.
The union demanded that every site be sold independently.
Poundland has no interested buyers for any stores.
tasks.correct_answer: It says selling stores separately could recover more money for creditors.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי מקורב לחברה, פירוק ומכירת חנויות בנפרד עשויים להשיב יותר כסף לנושים.

tasks.prompt: What happened after Gordon Brothers rejected Martin Property Group's offer?
options: The government immediately bought Poundland.
All 600 stores closed the same day.
Three independent directors resigned after disagreeing with the decision.
Poundland's managers withdrew the administration notice.
tasks.correct_answer: Three independent directors resigned after disagreeing with the decision.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שלושה דירקטורים עצמאיים התפטרו לאחר שחלקו על ההחלטה לא לקבל את ההצעה הממומנת.

tasks.prompt: Identify three figures that show Poundland's scale or the seriousness of the crisis.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבחור שלושה נתונים מספריים מדויקים ולהסביר בקצרה מה כל אחד מראה.
expected_points: It has roughly 600 stores in the UK and Ireland.
It serves around 20 million customers a year.
The administration notice provides 10 days to seek a rescue deal.

tasks.prompt: Explain the disagreement between Poundland's management and Gordon Brothers about the best outcome for the business.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את שתי העמדות ולהשתמש בראיות מהכתבה.
expected_points: Management says sales are strong, recovery is taking root and the MPG bid could keep the company intact.
Gordon Brothers restricted funding and rejected the bid.
The owner's side argues that breaking up the chain could recover more for creditors and may transfer some staff to new store owners.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the events that put Poundland near administration and the possible next outcomes.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג את רצף האירועים ולפחות שני תרחישים אפשריים.
expected_points: Gordon Brothers limited Poundland's access to vital operating funds.
A fully funded offer from Martin Property Group was rejected.
Poundland filed notice of an intention to appoint administrators while seeking a rescue.
Possible outcomes include a pre-pack sale or a breakup with stores sold to other retailers.

tasks.prompt: Write a short briefing for Poundland employees explaining what is known, what remains uncertain and what support has been promised.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח עדכון מאוזן המבוסס על העובדות, ללא הבטחות שאינן בכתבה.
expected_points: State that the company has a 10-day period to seek a rescue deal.
Explain that jobs and ownership remain uncertain, with rescue, pre-pack or breakup options possible.
Mention that Andy Burnham said the government was ready to support the workforce and wanted answers about the rejected bid.
